title: Inspect and extend: Use XCTest and XcodeGen to check the sample
objective: Use the real implementation in `Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve core rule tests, temporary userdefaults, target generation, and simulator checklist.
problem: Tests isolate rules and persistence using controlled defaults. The XcodeGen file describes build targets; on macOS, generate and run the simulator suite before calling it verified. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift` and the related project files: Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift; project.yml; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to core rule tests, temporary userdefaults, target generation, and simulator checklist.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: This workspace lacked Xcode; build and UI behavior remain unverified.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Tests isolate rules and persistence using controlled defaults. The XcodeGen file describes build targets; on macOS, generate and run the simulator suite before calling it verified.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
